gloss: pi; ratio of circumference to diameter

definitions.gloss: pi (π); ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter
definitions.explanation: The mathematical constant pi (π), approximately 3.14159, representing the ratio of any circle's circumference to its diameter.

examples.japanese: {円周率|えんしゅうりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧3.14だ。
{円周率|えんしゅうりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧100⟦{桁|けた}→桁：03884_keta⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えている→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: I have memorized pi to 100 digits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{半径|はんけい}→半径：04331_hankei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二乗|にじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{円周率|えんしゅうりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: The area of a circle is found by multiplying the square of the radius by pi.
